sample_unit: clinicians rating ChatGPT responses to 20 Alzheimer's disease myths

links.outcome: Clinician-rated accuracy of ChatGPT explanations of Alzheimer's myths against expert judgment
links.effect: Mean (SD) clinician agreement score 1.0 (±0.3) across 20 myths; ChatGPT correctly identified all 20 myths as inaccurate; clinicians disagreed with explanations on 7 myths.
links.quote: While ChatGPT correctly identified that all the 20 myths were inaccurate, some clinicians disagreed with its explanations on 7 of the myths.

screen.reason: The study evaluated ChatGPT-4's performance in refuting Alzheimer's disease misinformation and simplifying language for patient education via clinician survey evaluation, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
